Machine Learning (BMI/GEO/WNA) 
Code Assignment U1A1  
Linear Regression 
 
10 marks 
Use real estate valuation regression dataset : 
https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/477/real+estate+valuation+data+set  from 
the UCI repository, and use google colab to code. 
 
First, download the csv file, and open it in your computer and analyze the data. 
Try to understand what the data is about. Read through the data description 
given 
in 
the 
UCI 
website 
as 
well. 
 
Section A 
Answer the following questions [1 mark if you answer all the below questions] 
: 
1. How many samples are there? 
414 
2. How 
many 
input 
variables 
are 
there? 
6 
3. Which 
column 
is 
the 
output 
variable 
(target 
outcome)? 
House price of unit area 
4. What 
does 
each 
of 
the 
input 
columns 
mean? 
X1->Transaction date:  Analysis on how house price changed over time 
can be found 
X2->House age -> Can analyze market value of house. Old and new 
house have different market values. 
X3-> Distance to nearest MRT -> Mass Rapid Transit Station- near to 
public transport- impact on price 
X4-> No of convenient stores- within walkable distance more number of 
stores- more convenient- impact on price

Page 2/5 
X5-> Latitude- > Help identify areas closer to major cities- high price as 
job opportunities more-> Help identify regional variations like climate 
etc. 
X6->Longitude-> help identify location and based on the location- 
market value 
 
 
Section B 
 
1. Understanding the dataset [4 marks] 
There are many input variables in this dataset. Use only X1 to X4 as input 
variables, and y as the output variable. 
Using the scatter plots between each of the input features (X1-X4) and the 
output (Y), which input variable, do you think, is better in predicting the output 
/ target variable? 
1) X1- Transaction Date V/s House price 
 
 
 
2) X2- House age V/s House price

Page 3/5 
 
3) X3 distance to the nearest MRT station V/s House price 
 
 
4) X4 number of convenience stores V/s House price

Page 4/5 
 
 
<<Input X2 – ‘Distance to the nearest MRT station ‘ seems to better predict 
house price>> 
 
2. Write code to find out how many samples are there in total in this dataset? [1 
mark] 
 
 
3. What is the train test split ratio that you have chosen? [1 Mark] 
 
 
<< Train to Test split = 70:30 >>

Page 5/5 
 
4. Evaluate the linear regression model by computing the MAE, MSE and Mean 
Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) . 
(for MAPE - pls refer to the sample here - https://scikit-
learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.mean_absolute_percent
age_error.html)  
[3 marks] 
 
Parameters:  
Y_test:  array-like of shape  
Ground truth (correct) target values (House price) 
Y_pred:  array-like of shape  
 Estimated target value 
 
 
 
5. What are the 3 new things that you learned after you completed this 
assignment? 
<< 1) Deep understanding so as to implement with any dataset 
2) Error calculation and analysis 
3) Familiarization of new terms, coding skills >>
